title: AdapterHeartbeatV1
description: MBR-207 per-client adapter heartbeat and mechanism receipt. One envelope per client; the supervisor upserts the most recent record into a HeartbeatTable keyed by clientId and refuses any client reported as both installed and delivering. Canonical Rust source of truth: engine/crates/membrane-protocol/src/heartbeat.rs (AdapterHeartbeatV1).

clientId.description: Stable opaque client identifier (e.g. cursor, windsurf, claude, codex, windsurf-mcp).

adapterVersion.description: Adapter self-declared semver-ish version; never parsed by the supervisor.

status.description: Adapter self-declared status; the supervisor may upgrade or downgrade this during summarize_status but never below the truth the adapter asserted.

lastSeen.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC instant at which the heartbeat was minted; the supervisor compares it against now() to compute staleness.

mechanism.description: Stable mechanism name, e.g. membrane_context, membrane_source_read.

scopeGrant.description: Scope-grant id that authorised the most recent delivery under this mechanism.

lastUsed.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC instant at which the mechanism was last exercised.

count.description: Cumulative delivery count under this mechanism; a receipt is 'hot' when strictly greater than zero.

mechanismReceipts.description: One receipt per mechanism the adapter has actually exercised; an empty list is valid and means 'active but not delivering'.
